about_the_game:
One-line Summary

"The Bell Echoes" is a narrative-driven SRPG Roguelite.

Core Features

> >High-Density Tactical Combat: 3-Man Squad × Action-Oriented Turns

Say goodbye to tedious map exploration and dive straight into an intense 8×8 grid. You command a 3-person squad where each character wields up to 7 skills. Execute a full action combo in a single turn: "Dash → Crowd Control → Chain Attack." Utilize height differences to suppress enemies behind cover, trigger chain damage via Knockback and Collision, and dodge fatal strikes with precise positioning. The grid may be small, but every move shifts the tide of battle.

> >Roguelite-Style Build Freedom

In every run, you must choose from a massive array of talents and skill variants, along with unique equipment and gems. Craft a unique, invincible squad that is yours alone.

> >Detective-Style Narrative Progression

This is not your traditional "Savior" story. You must tread upon polluted lands to piece together the truth of "Project Black Needle," surviving in the cracks between the Imperial Army, Marauders, and old allies. Remember: Don't jump to conclusions too quickly.

> >A Unique "Stress" System

On this contaminated soil, combat consumes not just stamina, but sanity. When stress hits its limit, will your character fall into [Despair], or awaken the power of [Meditation] in a desperate crisis? It all depends on your decisions.

Contact Us

Please leave us a message in the Steam discussion group, or send us an email at 382330596@qq.com.

——————————————

The demo currently supports Simplified Chinese only. We plan to gradually add support for other languages in the future.
